titulo_fr: Un article qui propose des solutions : Observer les formes
titulo_es: An article with proposals: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It relates a social problem to its causes, proposals and possible limits. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It relates a social problem to its causes, proposals and possible limits. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: The causal and concessional connectors organize a reasoning; the conditional can present prudent proposals. In this fragment, «collecte» means «recogida».

bloques.titulo: Un article qui propose des solutions

frases.fr: Une association propose des points de collecte où l'on peut déposer les emballages réutilisables.
frases.es: Una asociación propone puntos de recogida donde se pueden dejar los envases reutilizables.
frases.en: An association proposes collection points where reusable packaging can be left.

frases.fr: La mesure réduirait le plastique, à condition que les commerces acceptent de participer.
frases.es: La medida reduciría el plástico, siempre que los comercios aceptaran participar.
frases.en: The measure would reduce the plastic, provided that the shops agreed to participate.
